---
title: "Fit MOSM GP to 2-band synthetic example"
format: 
  html:
    embed-resources: true
---

This notebook contains the workflow for:

- loading groundtruth 2-band (MOGP) time-series, 
- fitting a MOSK GP model, 
- drawing posterior predictive samples,
- visualising the posteriors .

```{r message=FALSE}
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(cmdstanr)
library(posterior)
library(bayesplot)
library(readr)
library(glue)

register_knitr_engine(override = FALSE)

theme_set(theme_bw())
color_scheme_set("viridis")

source(here("mogp-utils.R"))

filename_stub <- "D2-Q3-seed6016-n300-mnar0.3-noise0.05"

EXECUTE_SAMPLING <- TRUE

N_CHAINS <- 4
N_WARMUP <- 500
N_SAMPLES <- 500

# Function estimates the mode of a sample
estimate_mode <- function(x) {
  d <- density(x, n = 2^6)
  d$x[which.max(d$y)]
}
```

```{r}
input_df <- read_csv(
  here("data", glue("{filename_stub}-sim.csv")), 
  col_types = "dddf",
  show_col_types = FALSE)

input_params <- read_tsv(
  here("data", glue("{filename_stub}-param.tsv")), 
  show_col_types = FALSE)

input_df |> 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = t, y = y, colour = factor(d)) +
  geom_linerange(aes(ymax = y + y_se, ymin = y - y_se), colour = "black") +
  geom_point() +
  labs(colour = "Band")
```

```{r}
input_params
```

# Model Fitting

```{r}
stan_model <- cmdstan_model(here("stan", "mosmgp-D2-Q.stan"))
```

## Sampling

```{r}
D <- 2
Q <- 3 

band1_df <- filter(input_df, d == 1)
band2_df <- filter(input_df, d == 2)

data_list <- list(
  Q = Q,
  N1 = length(band1_df$t),
  N2 = length(band2_df$t),
  t1 = band1_df$t,
  t2 = band2_df$t,
  y1 = band1_df$y,
  y2 = band2_df$y,
  y1_se = band1_df$y_se,
  y2_se = band2_df$y_se
)
```

### Priors

$$w \sim \mathcal{N}_+(0, 1), \quad \mu \sim \mathcal{N}(0, 3), \quad \Sigma \sim \mathcal{N}(0, 3), \quad \theta_2 \sim \mathcal{N}(0, 1), \quad \phi_2 \sim \mathrm{U}[-\pi, \pi]$$

```{r}
format(start_time <- Sys.time())

if (EXECUTE_SAMPLING) {
  init_fun <- function() {
    list(
      mu1 = sort(c(0.79, 2.72, 0.2) + rnorm(Q, 0, 0.1)),
      mu2 = c(0.93, 2.81, 0.19) + rnorm(Q, 0, 0.1)
    )
  }

  output <- stan_model$sample(
    data = data_list,
    init = init_fun,
    chains = N_CHAINS,
    parallel_chains = N_CHAINS,
    iter_warmup = N_WARMUP,
    iter_sampling = N_SAMPLES,
    refresh = 500,
    show_exceptions = FALSE,
    show_messages = TRUE
  )
  
  output$save_object(
    here("RDS", glue("{filename_stub}_mosmgp-D{D}-Q{Q}.RDS")))
  
} else {
  output <- readRDS(
    here("RDS", glue("{filename_stub}_mosmgp-D{D}-Q{Q}.RDS")))
}

format(finish_time <- Sys.time())
difftime(finish_time, start_time)  
```

# Results

```{r}
vars <- c("w", "mu", "Sigma", "theta", "phi")
output$summary(variables = vars, 
               posterior::default_convergence_measures())
```

```{r}
mcmc_trace(output$draws(vars))
```

```{r}
valid_chains <- c(1:4)
output_draws <- output$draws(variables = vars, format = "df") |> 
  subset_draws(chain = valid_chains)
output_draws_mat <- as.matrix(output_draws)

summary(output_draws)
```

## Posterior Predictive Check

### Target locations

```{r}
n_star <- 100
ts1 <- seq(from = 0, to = 10, length.out = n_star)
ts2 <- ts1
```


```{r}
# Draw posterior predictive samples using a particular posterior draw
r <- sample.int(nrow(output_draws_mat), 1)
this_post <- output_draws_mat[r,]

pp_draw <- pred_D2_Q1_draw(this_post, t1 = band1_df$t, t2 = band2_df$t, y1 = band1_df$y, y2 = band2_df$y, y1_se = band1_df$y_se, y2_se = band2_df$y_se, ts1 = ts1, ts2 = ts2)

ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = pp_draw, aes(x = ts, y = fs, colour = d)) +
  geom_point(data = input_df, aes(x = t, y = y), size = 0.5) +
  labs(colour = "Band")
```

```{r}
pp_draws <- pred_D2_Q1(draws = output_draws_mat, 
                       t1 = band1_df$t, 
                       t2 = band2_df$t, 
                       y1 = band1_df$y, 
                       y2 = band2_df$y, 
                       y1_se = band1_df$y_se, 
                       y2_se = band2_df$y_se, 
                       ts1 = ts1, 
                       ts2 = ts2, 
                       n_draws = 100)

ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = pp_draws, aes(x = ts, y = fs, group = interaction(d,.draw), colour = d)) +
  geom_point(data = input_df, aes(x = t, y = y), size = 1) +
  labs(colour = "Band")
```

## Hyperparameter Posteriors

```{r}
input_params # ground truth
```

```{r}
posterior_means <- as.data.frame(output_draws) |> 
  select(matches(vars), -.draw) |> 
  colMeans()
posterior_means
```

```{r}
posterior_modes <- sapply(select(as.data.frame(output_draws), matches(vars), -.draw), estimate_mode)
posterior_modes
```

```{r}
diff(input_params$theta)
posterior_means['theta[2]']
```

```{r}
output_draws |> 
  as.data.frame() |> 
  select(.draw, starts_with("w[")) |> 
  pivot_longer(2:3) |> 
  drop_na(value) |> 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = value) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
  facet_wrap(vars(name), scales = "free_y")
```
